questions.a: Franchise management software helps a franchisor run a network of independently operated locations from one system. Depending on the tool, it covers franchisee recruiting and onboarding, training, royalty tracking, compliance audits, field operations and performance reporting. It replaces the spreadsheets and phone calls that stop working once your network grows.

questions.q: When does a restaurant franchise need dedicated management software?
questions.a: Most brands feel the need once they grow beyond a handful of locations. At that point you're managing a network of independent operators, and keeping standards, training and reporting consistent by hand gets unsustainable. Software gives you one place to see what's happening at every unit.

questions.q: What features matter most in restaurant franchise software?
questions.a: It depends on your biggest challenge. Franchise lifecycle platforms handle development, onboarding, royalties and audits, while operations tools focus on digital SOPs, checklists, food safety logs and inspections. Back-office platforms cover accounting, inventory, labor and food cost, and POS systems let you push menu and pricing changes to every location.

questions.q: How do I choose franchise management software for my brand?
questions.a: Look at how purpose-built the tool is for franchises, how easily both franchisors and franchisees adopt it, whether the pricing is fair for the features, how well it scales and how good the vendor's support is. Then match the tool to your stage, since some platforms suit emerging franchisors and others are built for large enterprise systems. Ask for a demo with your own workflows.

questions.q: How do franchises keep brand standards consistent across locations?
questions.a: Most use digital checklists, SOPs and regular audits so every shift follows the same procedures, with corrective actions assigned when something slips. Real-time dashboards show which locations are meeting standards and which aren't. Tools that are mobile-friendly tend to get used by floor staff, which is where consistency is won or lost.

questions.q: How can a franchisor track guest experience at every location?
questions.a: Bring reviews and guest feedback from every location into one place and track sentiment by store and topic. Momos does this for restaurant and hospitality franchises with a Unified Inbox, AI-written replies from its agent Alfie and analytics that show what drives positive and negative reviews. You can see where incidents happen most and fix issues before they spread across locations.
